title: Mermaid Cove - Vacation Rental in Seacrest Beach West,FL | 30a Escapes
description_expanded: 30A ESCAPES presents..."Mermaid Cove," your Gulf-front getaway in Seacrest West! Wake up to waves, step onto sugar-white sands, and soak in endless ocean views. This cozy 2-suite townhome right on the beach offers laid-back luxury just 1-min walk from the serene community pool and a short bike ride to the charm of Alys and Rosemary Beaches. Enjoy sunset beach strolls and exploring 30A’s best with the 3 bikes provided. Learn more below...*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Gulf-front townhome with breathtaking ocean views – Wake up to stunning, panoramic views of the ocean every morning, filling your stay with tranquility and inspiration.Direct beach access just steps from the patio – Feel the sand between your toes in seconds! Enjoy ultimate convenience for beach walks, sunbathing, or a quick dip in the waves.Community pool for fun and relaxation – Whether it's a refreshing swim or simply lounging poolside with a good book, the pool is your perfect spot to unwind.Convenient location close to Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach – Explore charming coastal towns, boutique shops, and local dining, all just under 10-min bike ride away.Includes 3 bikes to explore 30A – Discover the beauty of the area with a relaxing bike ride along the scenic 30A trail.Private parking for 2 cars – Enjoy the convenience of dedicated parking spaces, making your stay hassle-free.Fits up to 6 guests with 2 bedrooms and 2.5 bathrooms – The Gulf-front primary suite offers stunning views, a private balcony, and a relaxing retreat. The second bedroom has a Twin-over-Full bunk bed with a Twin Trundle, great for kids and extra guests.Eager to Read More?Here Are A Few Kind Words From Our Previous Guests:⭐ "Unbelievable view! Steps to the beach and very comfortable beds. Hosts were incredibly responsive!" – Melissa G.⭐ "The location is perfect for families. You’re on the beach, plus the house is clean and spacious. Highly recommend!" – Courtney H.⭐ "Great stay at Mermaid Cove — perfect location for easy beach days with kids. Would definitely stay again!" – Kate H.*** LIVING AREAS ***Experience the perfect blend of comfort and coastal elegance in this beautifully renovated, open-concept living space. The living room boasts expansive glass doors that showcase breathtaking Gulf views and lead directly to the Gulf-front patio. Unwind on brand-new, stylish furniture while soaking in the tranquil atmosphere or stepping out for instant beach access.Spacious open-concept living room featuring plush seating and stunning Gulf viewsSeamless access to a private beachfront patioContemporary design adorned with elegant, stylish details*** KITCHEN AND DINING ***Create mouthwatering dishes in a modern, fully equipped kitchen featuring stainless steel appliances and generous counter space. The spacious dining table nearby offers an inviting setting for shared meals, all while taking in stunning Gulf views.Modern kitchen fully equipped with stainless steel appliances and a wine fridgeGenerous dining area with seating for up to 8, designed to accommodate everyone comfortablyIncludes a coffee maker and all essential cookware for your convenience*** OUTDOOR PRIVATE OASIS ***Savor your meals al fresco or begin your day with a coffee on the Gulf-front patio, just steps away from the sandy shore. From spotting dolphins at sunrise to soaking in the vibrant hues of a coastal sunset, Mermaid Cove offers a truly unforgettable outdoor experience.Gulf-front patio with outdoor dining area for 4Direct access to the pristine white-sand beach and outdoor shower as an extra perkCommunity pool located nearby, just 1 minute walk away*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***1st Floor:Half Bathroom next to the entry2nd Floor:Primary Suite: King-size bed, smart TV, private Gulf-view balcony with loungers, en-suite bathroom with a tiled shower and double vanityBunk Room: Twin-over-Full bunk bed with Twin Trundle, smart TV, private balcony, and en-suite bathroom*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***Nestled along the iconic Scenic Highway 30A, Mermaid Cove enjoys a coveted location between Alys Beach and Seagrove Beaches. Guests can take advantage of the 2 beach bikes to explore the area’s renowned coastal beauty, charming boutiques, and exceptional dining experiences.Alys Beach - A 4-minute bike ride takes you to this stunning, picturesque town with whitewashed architecture and an upscale, serene atmosphere.Rosemary Beach - Only an 8-minute drive, this charming coastal community offers upscale dining, boutique shopping, and idyllic beach vibes.The Big Chill - A 3-min drive to a lively spot for live entertainment, casual dining, and family fun, perfect for creating unforgettable memories.Publix Supermarket - Just a short 5-min drive away, perfect for grabbing grocery essentials and staying stocked up.*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included but can be purchased separately.We DO NOT accept wire transfers for payment.Waiver required to get access to the 3 provided bikes. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A Escapes.LSV (Low Speed Vehicles) are NOT allowed in Rosemary Beach, Seacrest, or Alys Beach.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***TDT #: 211534STRO #: STR-211534

Accessibility: Path to Entrance Lit at Night
Essentials: Olive Oil and Salt & Pepper Starter Supplies
